our techniques for improving the TF-IDF based on hyperlinked neighboring pages can improve the effectiveness of Web page characterization.

the TF-IDF values of the words in a Web page can be improved by using the hyperlinks of the Web page and the contents of the hyperlinked neighboring pages, and that the effectiveness of the proposed techniques depends on the number of hyperlinks in a Web page.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three issues.
improving the performance of a search engine for a Web page by using the contents not only of the Web page itself but also of its neighboring pages.
the improvement in the TF-IDF (term frequency-inverse document frequency) scheme for Web pages by using the contents (i.e. text) of hyperlinked neighboring (or linked) pages in an IR system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed technique is effective in improving the TF-IDF-based document characterization for Web pages.
the proposed techniques improve the accuracy of the Web pages characterization based on the TF-IDF.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we proposed a novel method for Web page classification based on a combination of TF-IDF and hyperlinked neighboring pages. © 2005 John Wiley & Sons, Inc.

we propose an effective method for improving the TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) scheme for Web pages by using the contents and the hyperlink structure of hyperlinked neighboring documents.
we proposed a new TF-IDF scheme to characterize a Web page based on the contents in the neighboring pages of the Web page.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can improve the TF-IDFs of the words of a Web page by taking into account not only the contents of the Web page, but also the contents of the pages hyperlinked to it.

the TF-IDF scores of Web pages can be improved by taking into account the contents of the hyperlinked neighboring pages, and the improvement is especially significant when the contents of a Web page are short.
the contents of hyper-linked neighboring pages can be used to improve the characterization of Web pages in IR systems based on the vector model.
